title: High-Stress Si3N4 Reflective Membranes Monolithically Integrated with Cavity Bragg Mirrors
summary: High-stress silicon nitride (Si3N4) membranes represent the state-of-the-art for cavity optomechanics, combining ultralow dissipation, optical transparency, and full compatibility with wafer-scale nanofabrication. Yet their integration into high-finesse optical cavities has remained difficult, typically requiring bonding or alignment-sensitive assembly that limits scalability and long-term stability.
